query: WITH entities AS ((SELECT id FROM vf_accounts WHERE (id > $3) AND ($3 IS NOT NULL) AND ((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM vf_account_flags f WHERE f.account_id = vf_accounts.id) >= $1) ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT $2) UNION ALL (SELECT id FROM vf_accounts WHERE ($3 IS NULL) AND ((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM vf_account_flags f WHERE f.account_id = vf_accounts.id) >= $1) ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT $2) ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT $2) SELECT i.id AS "entity_id!: Repo__Id", e.sequence, e.event, CASE WHEN $4 THEN e.context ELSE NULL::jsonb END as "context: es_entity::ContextData", e.recorded_at, NULL::jsonb as "forgettable_payload?" FROM entities i JOIN vf_account_events e ON i.id = e.id ORDER BY i.id asc, i.id, e.sequence
